messages:
maria (sec): Heads-up: we need a compact SIEM-snapshot request template for IR & vuln triage. Must call out: who does KMS unwrap, snapshot TTL, ephemeral RBAC duration, chain-of-custody fields, and whether scrub required. tagging @dina @jon for ops flow suggestions.

dina (oncall): We used a tiny format during triage last week. Kept TTL=48h, infra does the unwrap via kms-proxy, analyst gets ephemeral role, and we log audit + ticket.

jon (infra): Confirm 48h is our default. Legal holds can extend up to 7d with documented approval. Important: never give direct CMK decrypt to humans. Always route through the KMS proxy that issues short-lived plaintext to the CI job. kms-bot should emit an unwrap entry.

kms-bot: Note: unwrap requests require justification, ticket_id, approver. All unwrap events are logged to audit.kms with the requestor identity and nonce.

maria (sec): Can someone drop a copy/pasteable request body we can surface in the runbook? Want minimal fields only.

eli (sre): Paste-ready template below. Use it as the canonical minimal request.

```
Request: FOR-INC-2026 (short description)
TTL: 48h (max default)
Datasets: auth-logs, web-proxy, app-traces (list)
Purpose: vuln-triage / forensics
KMS unwrap: via security-kms-proxy
Ephemeral role: ephemeral/forensics-FOR-INC-2026 (expires=48h)
Approver: sec_oncall (must be named)
Justification: suspected credential compromise
Ticket: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/FOR-INC-2026
Chain-of-custody: ticket + snapshot-tag + action-log
Export_policy: no external transfers; if sharing internally use presigned URL (expiry=1h)
Scrub: auth-pii-minimize (optional, required if PII present)
```

anika (prod): Add explicit line: 'destination buckets must be CMK-wrapped'. Also require a field: 'PII_YN: yes/no' so legal can triage before unwrap.

maria (sec): Good call. Sam, does legal want the PII flag and an approval note for >48h?

sam (legal): Yes. Add PII_YN and if yes, require scrub-first or written sign-off. For TTL >48h we need Product/PO + Legal approval recorded in the ticket. 7d is the upper bound.

eli (sre): Operational notes for runbook: 1) infra-runner creates snapshot and tags with ticket and retention label; 2) scrubber runs (if flagged) producing a wrapped artifact; 3) infra triggers kms-proxy unwrap to supply keys to ephemeral VM; 4) ephemeral role is created and OPA enforces expiry; 5) all actions logged to audit.kms and audit.access.

jon (infra): Implementation bits: use CI job `infra/snapshot:create --ticket=FOR-INC-2026 --ttl=48h --datasets=auth,proxy` which returns snapshot-id. Then `infra/snapshot:tag --id=$ID --ticket=$TICKET --retention=48h`. Ephemeral role windows are created via IAM service with TTL policy enforced by OPA.

dina (oncall): What about presigned URLs? Keep lifetime 1h. If someone needs longer sharing must update ticket with reason and get infra + legal sign-off.

maria (sec): I'll update the runbook with the template + the command snippets and the legal checklist. Can we include the scrub command example?

eli (sre): Sure, example scrub step: `scrubber --dataset auth-logs --rules auth-pii-minimize --mode remove-identifiers --ticket FOR-INC-2026` and ensure output is re-keywrapped to bucket with CMK.

jon (infra): And a final note in runbook: do not allow persistent snapshots in dev environments; snapshots must live in controlled staging/forensics buckets only.

maria (sec): Thanks all, will publish and ping again when done. :thumbsup:
